name: Monasteries of Daphni, Hosios Loukas and Nea Moni of Chios
description: Three Byzantine monasteries, one near Athens (Daphni), one near Delphi (Hosios Loukas) and one on the Aegean island of Chios (Nea Moni), are linked by a shared design. Each church has a broad dome rising over a square plan. Inside, 11th- and 12th-century mosaics glow against gold backgrounds, set among fine marble work from Byzantium's second golden age.
